# Scientific Evidence Ledger

Every load-bearing statement in OsteoQuant materials should trace to one row here. Categories:
**V** verified fact (primary source fetched this session) · **RF** published research finding ·
**CC** company claim · **EX** existing experimental evidence from others · **R** *actual result generated by this
project* (synthetic unless stated) · **A** assumption · **H** commercial hypothesis · **U** unresolved.
Detailed citations: docs/science/REFERENCES.md, docs/research/COMPETITOR_INTELLIGENCE.md, grants/FUNDING_OPPORTUNITIES.md.

## 2. Actual results generated by this project (see EXPERIMENT_REGISTRY.md for full numbers)
| # | Result | Data | Cat. |
|---|---|---|---|
| R1 | Morphometry agrees with **Scanco IPL** on 8 public trabecular cubes: Tb.Th ICC(2,1)=0.983 (mean −2.4%), Tb.Sp ICC=0.948 (−4.1%) with the edge border convention; background convention under-reads (−18%/−34%). Caveat Q-10: the edge convention was selected after seeing these 8 cubes — not an independent validation | **Real public data** (Zenodo 11061947) | R |
| R2 | Morphometry is exact on analytic objects (plates: thickness exact for even voxel counts, +1 voxel for odd; β1 exact; BV/TV exact); digitised rods read ~1 voxel thin | analytic | R |
| R3 | When graft density lies inside the new-bone range (800–1000 mgHA/cm³), the **Dice-optimal intensity-only oracle** (upper bound for any voxel-wise intensity rule) gives graft Dice 0.52–0.77 depending on noise; an RF with shape/texture features reaches 0.85–0.92 **only when granules are compact**; with strut-like granules oracle 0.36, RF 0.70. (Corrected 2026-11-27 after independent review Q-01: an earlier "Bayes bound" was the accuracy-optimal rule, not a Dice bound.) Caveat Q-02: RF "full" features include distance to the *true* ROI | synthetic | R |
| R4 | Registered **day-0 graft footprint** gives graft Dice 0.915 (overlap regime, compact granules) and **0.816 with strut-like granules** where single-timepoint RF gives 0.663, multi-Otsu 0.318 and the intensity oracle 0.323; rigid TRE < 4 µm. Caveat Q-11: best case — the simulated graft only shrinks in place (no migration/fragmentation/swelling) | synthetic | R |
| R5 | Synthetic-trained 3D U-Net on held-out synthetic specimens: new-bone Dice 0.861, graft 0.918, host 0.960, ECE 0.008 | synthetic | R |
| R6 | Explicit ROI-context input channel gave **no benefit** (0.866/0.919 without vs 0.861/0.918 with) | synthetic | R (hypothesis component not supported) |
| R7 | Cross-scanner gain/offset shift drops RF graft Dice 0.96→0.81; percentile normalisation restores 0.96 | synthetic | R |
| R8 | Adaptation to held-out simulated materials: zero-shot graft Dice 0.84 (bioglass 0.79); 1 labelled scan → 0.86–0.89; 3 → 0.91 | synthetic | R |
| R9 | Real Zeiss TXM ingestion: ovine callus file PixelSize = **24.6 µm** (founder playbook stated 3.72 µm) | **Real public data** | R / correction |
| R10 | Automatic segmental-gap ROI on the real 18-day ovine scan found the regenerate with confidence 0.56 (flagged for review); the 161-day scan was correctly returned as an exception (consolidated regenerate, saturated hardware) | Real public data | R |
| R12 | **Real micro-CT (dog forelimb, 5 test specimens):** U-Net trained on 10 real scans Dice 0.826 vs Otsu 0.508 / RF 0.758; synthetic-trained U-Net fails zero-shot (0.379) but reaches 0.787 after fine-tuning on ONE real labelled scan | **Real public data** (Zenodo 24047383) | R |
| R11 | Classical thresholds on real reconstructions must exclude out-of-FOV padding and metal: without this, new-bone fraction was 1.00; with it 0.21 | Real public data | R (defect found & fixed) |

## 5. Assumptions (must be replaced by measurement)
| Assumption | Where used | Replace with |
|---|---|---|
| Graft microporosity (HA 30%, β-TCP 60%, BCP 50%, CaSO4 35%, 45S5 40%) | phantom materials | measured micro-CT of each product (physical phantom) |
| Material resorption rates and spatial pattern (near-wall faster), creeping substitution 50% | phantom generator | literature per material + histology |
| Woven-bone mineral 650–1000 mgHA/cm³ by maturity | phantom generator | calibrated in vivo scans |
| Granule morphology (spheres with low-order roughness) | phantom generator — **drives R3** | real granule scans (physical phantom E2) |
| Reviewer effort: 20 s/slice review vs 90 s/slice manual | Experiment M | timed user study with analysts |

## 6. Commercial hypotheses (untested; no interviews done)
Generation-2 pricing hypotheses (superseding the Gen-1 $12K/$25K/$4K/$40K figures): paid pilot $2.5–5K; non-GLP study
analysis $8–15K; material characterisation $5–15K; academic licence $4–10K/yr; enterprise licence $30–75K/yr
(business/REVENUE_MODEL.md, business/PRICING_VALIDATION_PLAN.md). No GLP package is offered. Analyst time saving is an
assumption-derived model output, not a measurement (EVIDENCE_LEDGER G2-002). Reachable market recomputed at the new
prices ≈$0.8–3.9M/yr (bottom-up hypothesis, business/REVENUE_MODEL.md).

## 7. Unresolved
Real graft-vs-new-bone separability for any commercial material; real cross-scanner transfer; whether CROs already have
satisfactory DL pipelines; willingness to pay; whether a day-0 in vivo scan is obtainable in customers' study designs;
OTM ownership position; device-status opinion.
